known_defects.defect: --check prints 'warning: two edges share 2 cell(s), including ports; increase routing space'
known_defects.explanation: this is the bus's own source port cell and its single hub cell shared by the corridor and its spurs. The source demands one split, and the renderer's hub mode (1-2 spurs) always shares those two cells; the only warning-free alternative is 3 spurs, which reports 3 junctions instead of the one split the source asks for (measured: same graph, branches [bmc_s,pwr,spare] -> '3 branches, 3 junctions', no warning). Kept the source-faithful form and recorded the warning raw.
